sources.snippet: Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. This repository is a curated collection of pre-trained, state-of-the-art models in the ONNX format.

sources.title: beclab/PP-DocLayoutV3_onnx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: PP-DocLayoutV3 is specifically engineered to handle non-planar document images. It can directly predict multi-point bounding boxes for layout elements—as opposed to standard two-point boxes—and determine logical reading orders for skewed and curved surfaces within a single forward pass, significantly reducing cascading errors. This model is an essential component of PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 ...

sources.title: PP-DocLayoutV3 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: PP-DocLayoutV3 is a unified and high-efficiency model designed for comprehensive layout analysis. It addresses the challenges of complex physical distortions—such as skewing, curving, and adverse lighting—by integrating instance segmentation and reading order prediction into a single, end-to-end framework.
